Maker is a decentralized finance protocol on the Ethereum blockchain that operates without intermediaries. Maker issues the DAI stablecoin through collateralized debt positions. Maker is governed by holders of the MKR token.

Curve Finance is a decentralized exchange that operates through smart contracts on public blockchains. Curve Finance specializes in swapping stablecoins and similar assets with low slippage. Curve Finance uses an automated market maker design.

Lido is a liquid staking protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain. Lido issues the stETH token, which represents ether staked through the protocol. Lido operates through smart contracts without intermediaries.

DAI is a decentralized stablecoin that is designed to be pegged to the US dollar. DAI is issued by the Maker protocol. DAI is collateralized by crypto assets held in the Maker system.

Compound is a decentralized lending and borrowing protocol built on smart contracts on the Ethereum blockchain. Compound sets interest rates algorithmically based on supply and demand. Compound is governed by holders of the COMP token.
